Detailed Description

file-related functions abstracting the backends

other parts of evidence interact with these exclusively. if the op is common to all backends, it is handled in here; otherwise, it is forwarded to the selected backend (which in turn may call generic helpers in here).

pthread_mutex_t *  mutex
) 
 

get all meta-data (including those provided by plugins) for a given file usually for displaying it in a tooltip or properties dialog function will work on a copy of the file-info, hence if a mutex is given, the model is locked briefly while copying the existing file-info, then unlocked for however long it takes to acquire the meta-data, and finally locked again to copy the attributes over to the caller's file-info element.

Returns:
an error-code
Parameters:
info the file-info to store the resulting info on
mutex the mutex of the model to lock while changing the file-info element
